subject.title: Feature: configurable dateFormat (UK/US/ISO) for envelope and system-event date display

question: Should OpenClaw accept a new `agents.defaults.dateFormat` display option for model-visible envelope and system-event dates, and if so what enum and scope should be supported?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but this adds public config surface and changes prompt-visible timestamp semantics, so automation should not choose the product contract unilaterally.

options.title: Approve narrow display enum
options.body: Add a default-ISO `dateFormat` enum scoped to agent-visible envelope and system-event display only, with schema/docs/tests and no effect on filenames or machine-readable fields.

options.title: Keep ISO-only prompt dates
options.body: Close or reject the config expansion and keep model-visible dates sortable and unambiguous, while documenting that downstream presentation layers may reformat dates.

options.title: Defer for broader time UX
options.body: Keep this open until maintainers settle related timezone/date-display requests together, avoiding one-off config growth.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow display enum
recommendation.body: Add a default-ISO `dateFormat` enum scoped to agent-visible envelope and system-event display only, with schema/docs/tests and no effect on filenames or machine-readable fields.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history across envelope timestamp config, date/time docs, and the current shared formatter ownership boundary.
